name: Fujibayashi Hajiki
source:
A famous streamer who teaches Yukimi about the streaming business.
Under the stage name Captain Hype, he posts about travel and city experiences. Thanks to his natural energetic drive and somewhat flashy persona, he has earned great popularity, eclipsing over five million subscribers.
The very person who encouraged Yukimi to become a game streamer. She considers Hajiki to be not just a friend, but also a mentor whom she can turn to and freely discuss the secrets of streaming or whatever is troubling her.

[From in-game profile]
